description:
When MaxInflight is set to 1, if a MsgApp is lost, the Leader remains permanently paused.
The Leader's Inflights buffer is full (1/1).
Heartbeats continue, and the Follower responds with its current Match index (which is old).
However, the Leader does not use the HeartbeatResp to clear the Inflights buffer or trigger a resend when MaxInflight is full and the Match index indicates the Follower hasn't received the inflight entries.
This leads to a deadlock where the Leader never sends new entries or resends old ones.
